name: tape
description: A ticker tape above the prompt: live stock, index, gold, FX and crypto prices, keyless by default.

enabled.title: On
enabled.description: Off draws nothing, runs no timer and fetches nothing.

symbols.title: Symbols
symbols.description: Comma-separated. Stocks, indices, gold and FX as Hyperliquid lists them (AAPL, SP500, GOLD, EUR), crypto by name (BTC, ETH). Forty at most.

refresh.title: Refresh (seconds)
refresh.description: How often prices are fetched. At least 5; after a failure the wait doubles, up to five minutes, until the next success.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: scroll: a marquee moving a few cells a second, the pace in the speed setting; every step redraws the band, about 5% of a core at the default pace. rotate: pages of whole symbols that fit the band, flipped every few seconds, one redraw a page, close to free.

speed.title: Scroll speed (cells per second)
speed.description: How far the marquee moves each second when motion is scroll. Four reads at a glance; ten is the engine's ceiling for redraws.

rotateSeconds.title: Rotate every (seconds)
rotateSeconds.description: How long each page shows when motion is rotate.

alpacaKey.title: Alpaca key id (optional)
alpacaKey.description: With the secret below, stock symbols come as real-time IEX quotes from data.alpaca.markets under your own Alpaca account; crypto stays on Hyperliquid. Stored as a secret, never drawn or logged.

alpacaSecret.title: Alpaca secret key (optional)
alpacaSecret.description: The secret that goes with the key id above. Stored as a secret, never drawn or logged.
